verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS AI app builder, but the evidence shows Lovable runs only as a hosted service ("Lovable hosts your app", "nothing to install"). Exporting generated code to deploy outside Lovable, and the Supabase open-source foundation of the backend, concern the user's generated apps or the underlying platform, not a self-hostable Lovable core, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
